tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: warm paper (light), deep ink blue (dark). Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Outer cards and the form panel.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inner surfaces inside a card: open rows, hover rows, the selected period.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, card, raised, accent-soft (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, dates, one-line explainers on bg, card, raised (5.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, inner card borders, the section divider line. Decoration only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, unselected chips and toggles (3.7:1 on card: passes WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signature gold FILL: primary button, selected chip and toggle, progress bars, divider star, background stars. Light: deep gold with white text (6.8:1), 6.2:1 on bg. Dark: soft gold with dark text (8.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold TEXT: eyebrow labels, links, the active section in the nav (5.6:1 or more on every surface, both themes).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: white in light mode (6.8:1), near-black #1B1405 in dark mode (8.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet highlight: the 'You are here' row, the 'i' pop-up header band.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset (5.6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: tier-1
tokens.usage: Mahadasha level colour (long term): label text and progress bar. Same as accent-text.

tokens.name: tier-2
tokens.usage: Antardasha level colour (medium term).

tokens.name: tier-3
tokens.usage: Pratyantardasha level colour (short term). Levels also differ by label and bar height, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and the error edge of a field (6.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: soon-text
tokens.usage: 'Coming soon' tag text on soon-bg (6.5:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: soon-bg
tokens.usage: 'Coming soon' tag fill.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; field padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Heading to content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones (divider sits in the middle).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (divider sits in the middle).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, small inner rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner cards, the 'i' pop-up.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Outer cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the South/North toggle, progress bars, tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Outer cards in light mode only. Dark mode uses the line border, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The 'i' pop-up and menus, both themes.
